notes: Baseline = no skill (creating a new skill). Each eval points at a fixture copied into iteration-N/<name>/<cfg>/project. Prompts are Chinese; the skill must localize the report to the conversation language. Assertions are graded against the produced report file + the post-run state of project/.

evals.name: no-config-detect-and-roadmap
evals.prompt: 帮我看下 project/ 这个服务,我们准备让团队都用 Claude Code,但还没做任何配置。它符合 Claude Code 工程规范吗?给个评估。
evals.expected_output: Markdown audit report. Correctly reports NO Claude Code config (no CLAUDE.md/.claude/hooks/skills/MCP). Low band but constructive starting-point roadmap, not scolding. Org-level human-confirm section present. project/ untouched.

assertions.text: An audit report Markdown file was produced in outputs/ and is substantive (not a stub: has a score, category breakdown, and recommendations).
Correctly detects total absence of Claude Code config — explicitly states there is no CLAUDE.md, no .claude/ directory, and no hooks/skills/MCP.
The summary is framed as a constructive starting-point roadmap (where to begin), not as a scolding or pure list of failures.
Includes the organizational-governance human-confirm checklist section (the items a single repo cannot prove).
No file inside project/ was created, modified, or deleted (report is read-only; report written to outputs/, not into project/).
Reports an overall score in the lowest band (起步 / <50) consistent with zero configuration.
Top-priority recommendations name concrete first artifacts to add (at minimum a root CLAUDE.md), in a sensible starting order.

evals.name: quality-judgment-bloated-monorepo
evals.prompt: 审计一下 project/ 是否符合 Claude Code 大型代码库最佳实践,我感觉我们的 CLAUDE.md 有点乱但说不上来哪里有问题。
evals.expected_output: Audit that judges quality, not mere presence. Flags CLAUDE.md bloat, misplaced reusable domain knowledge, obsolete compensatory rule, missing subdir CLAUDE.md, linters-without-hooks, missing ignore, vague skill. project/ untouched.

assertions.text: A substantive audit report Markdown file was produced in outputs/.
Flags root CLAUDE.md bloat — calls out the generic software-engineering / JavaScript advice as noise the model already knows.
Identifies the long OAuth/authentication section as reusable domain knowledge that belongs in a Skill, not in CLAUDE.md.
Flags the 'edit one file at a time / no multi-file refactor' rule as a likely obsolete old-model compensatory rule that should be removed.
Flags that this multi-service repo (services/api, services/web) has no subdirectory CLAUDE.md scoping.
Flags that eslint+prettier are configured but no hook enforces these deterministic checks.
Flags generated/vendored dirs (dist/, services/web/build, node_modules) with no .claudeignore / exclusion configuration.
Flags the 'helper' skill's vague, non-triggering description as weak.
Does not blanket-reward presence — settings.json and the skill existing are not marked fully Compliant given their quality problems.
No file inside project/ was created, modified, or deleted.

evals.name: calibration-lean-small-project
evals.prompt: 这个小工具 project/ 就一个单文件脚本,帮我对照 Claude Code 规范检查下配置到不到位。
evals.expected_output: Audit calibrated to a tiny single-file project: short lean CLAUDE.md judged good; hierarchy/plugins/MCP/subagents marked N/A not ✗; score in 良好/优秀 band; org-level section present; project/ untouched.

assertions.text: A substantive audit report Markdown file was produced in outputs/.
The short ~8-line root CLAUDE.md is judged good/Compliant (lean = pointers + a real gotcha), NOT marked Missing/Partial merely for being short.
Subdirectory CLAUDE.md hierarchy is marked N/A (with a scale reason), not ✗ Missing.
At least two of {plugins/marketplace, subagent conventions, MCP} are marked N/A for project scale rather than ✗ Missing.
Overall score lands in the 良好 or 优秀 band — not artificially tanked for lacking org-scale machinery.
The organizational-governance human-confirm checklist section is still present.
No file inside project/ was created, modified, or deleted.

evals.name: well-configured-no-false-problems
evals.prompt: 我们这个平台仓库 project/ 配置 Claude Code 已经折腾挺久了,帮我做一次完整的工程规范合规审计,看还有没有漏的。
evals.expected_output: Audit recognizes a strong setup without manufacturing problems: layered CLAUDE.md, hooks incl. self-improvement, path-scoped skill, MCP, ignore, recent git all Compliant; 优秀 band; org section present; project/ untouched.

assertions.text: A substantive audit report Markdown file was produced in outputs/.
Recognizes the layered CLAUDE.md (root pointers + services/api + services/web) as Compliant.
Recognizes the hooks setup including the Stop/reflect self-improvement hook as Compliant.
Recognizes the path-scoped security-review skill (good description + allowed-paths) as Compliant.
Recognizes .mcp.json and .claudeignore as Compliant.
Uses git recency (~7 days) to judge configuration maintenance as recent/Compliant.
Overall score is in the 优秀 band (>=85).
Does not fabricate false ✗ findings — does not claim missing artifacts that actually exist in the repo.
The organizational-governance human-confirm checklist section is still present.
No file inside project/ was created, modified, or deleted.
